goal: Calibrate native parameter-curve component changes against completely enumerated known behaviors, before interpreting Pythia components semantically.
inputs: All 16 vectors in {-1,+1}^4, lexicographic order; coordinates a,b,c,d. d is irrelevant to every target.
architecture: 4 -> 8 tanh -> 8 tanh -> 1 logit (3 logits for joint)
dtype: float64 throughout training, transforms and interventions
training: Full-batch BCE on every possible input; fixed 800 steps; no hyperparameter search or early stopping.
curve_mapping: Each tensor independently flattened in existing C order. No neuron permutations, padding, alignment, truncation or tensor-boundary mixing.
components: Every node of a binary partition of rFFT bins, with each conjugate-paired complex bin indivisible
Every Haar wavelet-packet node at every divisible depth, splitting approximation and detail branches
interventions: Rollback: final weights minus the component projection of the interval update
Transplant: initial weights plus the identical component projection
behavior_measurement: All logits and signed probabilities on all 16 inputs; exact input-function Walsh expansion; accuracy and target margin. Input-function Walsh coordinates are distinct from native weight-curve coordinates.
interactions: For every parent and its two children, compare the parent's rollback effect to the sum of the child effects, in logits and probabilities separately.
reporting: Report all seeds and failed fits; selected illustrative cases are descriptive and labelled. Treat only within-model coordinates as corresponding.
limits: Finite Boolean tasks are orientation examples, not natural-language semantics, held-out generalization, grokking, sparse-feature recovery, or evidence for a curve-trained architecture advantage. Enumeration is exhaustive over the declared single components and sibling pairs, not all possible component subsets.
